subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 07/10] mountd: give each worker its own netlink command socket

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch addresses a problem in the mountd service where multiple worker processes share the same netlink command socket, leading to incorrect handling of requests and replies. To fix this, each worker is given its own netlink command socket by reopening the inherited sockets in the child process. This ensures that each request is handled correctly and prevents two workers from taking each other's acknowledgments or error messages during a round trip.
